show.title: Soulection Radio Show #140 w/ Esta & Andres
show.content:
ESTA and Andres stop on by and deliver solid sets.

<!--more-->

Had to start this show with a new unreleased gem from Kaytra and play all the classics/unreleased material as usual. Esta finally stopped by to drop an official set and talk about what's next for him. He really impressed us with his house vibes. This man is diverse. Andres also came through and graced us with a heavy hitter set. Spread this if you feel it.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #152 w/ LIKE (Pac Div)
show.content:
Due to all the adversity we went through with this show we had [LIKE](https://soundcloud.com/callmelike) play music past the last hour and extend all the way for a total of 3 hours & 39 minutes. 
<!--more-->

From the very first minute to the very end we were providing music that you never heard of or forgot about, configuring wires, figuring out audio issues, chopping it up about food, you name it. So much effort went into producing this show. We want to thank our brother LIKE for rolling through and blessing us with a proper DJ set, freestyle over Esta's beat, and talking to us about his experiences growing up and being in Pac Div. This man has traveled the world, played alongside the best in the game, and has also produced for/with the best (Kendrick, The Neptunes, ect). Joe Kay made sure to touch on topics that are very insightful. LIKE will be releasing with us on Soulection so stay tuned! 

Follow LIKE on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/Callmelike) | [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/clearlyitslike/) | [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/callmeLike/)


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #153 w/ Dream Koala
show.content:
Joe Kay kicked things off with heavy, heavy vibes from many brand new/unheard artists and collectives. 
<!--more-->

The selection in here was really well thought out and analyzed properly so take notes.

Shouts to Geode and the Chord Marauders who sent over their forthcoming compilation which is simply amazing. Pay attention to these guys, trust. Also look out for Sunni Colòn & Jarreau Vandal. These two artists will be breakthrough artists on Soulection in 2014; guaranteed. We had special guest Dream Koala stop by who is visiting LA for his 1st time all the way from Berlin (current residence but originally from Paris). The young 19 year old threw down a DJ set that included bass and uptempo tribal vibes. In fact, his set was very different from his original production. Dream Koala is very talented and we look forward to see and hear what's to come. 

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #156 w/ J-Louis
show.content:
Joe Kay is joined by Soulection's very own iPhone producer J-Louis.

<!--more-->
As some of you may or may not know, J-Louis produces all his music on the iPhone [(Nano Studio App)](https://apps.apple.com/gb/developer/blip-interactive-ltd/id382263654?at=1010lMz4). He even put out a free EP with us in the beginning of the year entitled ["Balanced"](https://soulection.bandcamp.com/album/balanced-ep) which was also produced entirely on the iPhone. This 20 year-old from Azusa, CA is really a special guy who we feel is going to be BIG in the near future as long as he stays on track with his progression.

J-Louis played an exclusive set for a little over 30 minutes with all his recent unreleased productions and then chopped it up with us about his musical background (Drummer since he was 8 years-old & played in a Hardcore band & toured when he was 12) and how he purchased a stolen Macbook Pro (without knowing) to start producing on a computer that was eventually stolen -- forcing him to produce on his iPhone again. 

What a journey! Joe Kay also made sure to talk about his experience at the Yeezus tour this past Friday and later went into a heavy discussion about rumors of Soulection being part of Free-masonry/Illuminati. Very interesting and informative conversations going on as always.


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #169
show.content:
Plenty of new music stacked ready to share with you.
<!--more-->

It felt good to be back after being away from the studio for 4 weeks. We've been traveling for the past month spreading The Sound of Tomorrow at SXSW, WMC, and now Asia. The pros of being away for so long meant that Joe stacked up on plenty of music for the past month which makes up for the lost time, trust. There is too much to say and talk about but shout out to all of the amazing people who came out to our shows to see and connect with us. We are very grateful!

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #195
show.content:
Joe Kay continues the freestyle of all music. 

<!--more-->
Last week's show was definitely one of my favorites to date. It's weird how things work. It's the shows that I feel most unprepared for that end up doing well... maybe it's because I just really freestyle and go off of my whole library of music rather than trying to curate a specific vibe. It was hard to top last week's show but I did my best to really take it right back to the early beat era from 2008-2012 and played some current gems as well. I hope you enjoy this. I'll be back next week with a guest maybe.

Bless.


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.
